objective: Determine whether keeping ordinary compiled RMSNorm for c1 and decode while applying R94's row-stable kernel to the packed c2 prefill is sufficient for exact c1/c2 output.

treatment.production_boundary: The 32-token threshold is valid only as a causal discriminator for this frozen fixture. It must not become a public or production rule because a single request can also exceed 31 tokens.

fixed_workload.sequence: Run cache-c000 alone at c1, then cache-c000 plus index-c001 at c2 on one fresh server and empty compile cache.

followup_if_pass: Replace the row-count discriminator with an explicit packed-multi-request-prefill signal that preserves the compiled fallback outside that phase, then repeat c1/c2 before clean-boot full qualification.
followup_if_fail: Preserve the result and compare exact sequences and dispatch receipts; do not tune the threshold around output tokens.
promotion_boundary: Diagnostic only. No public speed or quality authority; the discriminator is fixture-shaped and the current boot contains an earlier GPU reset.
